test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

King Midas said, "Daughter, take your breakfast and bring a few roses from the garden."

options.text: King Midas asked his daughter to take his breakfast and bring a few roses from the garden.
King Midas asked his daughter to take her breakfast and take a few roses from the garden.
King Midas asked his daughter to take her breakfast and bring a few roses from the garden.
King Midas asked his daughter to take her breakfast and brought a few roses from the garden.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. King Midas asked his daughter to take her breakfast and bring a few roses from the garden .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, the tense and pronouns are changed appropriately.
 
• The pronoun "her" is used in indirect speech as King Midas was addressing his daughter.
 
• The verb "bring" remains unchanged as it is part of the instruction.
 
• The correct option reflects both the instruction of taking breakfast and bringing roses accurately.

Correct sentence: *King Midas asked his daughter to take her breakfast and bring a few roses from the garden*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct Speech:** The original statement is quoted exactly as spoken by the speaker.
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The statement is paraphrased while maintaining the original meaning, with changes in tense, pronouns, and word order where necessary.
